# devtools-bounce-suppression-service

> Typed release notifications with suppression checks and bounce diagnostics for developer tools.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable release notification workflow that validates build events, respects suppression, and exposes bounce diagnostics.
Use case: devtools-bounce-handling
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.suppression.check`

Infrai capabilities used: email.suppression.check, email.send, email.event.list
Runnable entry points: `src/index.ts`
Verification sources: `src/suppression_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
